text: Codex app-server MCP startup notifications now carry nullable `threadId`, so subagent MCP failures stay scoped to the owning thread instead of polluting the parent transcript. App-server clients should handle the new field. PR: https://github.com/openai/codex/pull/26639

claims.text: Codex app-server MCP startup notifications now include nullable thread ownership.
Subagent MCP startup failures are scoped to the owning thread instead of polluting the parent transcript.
External app-server clients with strict schemas should accept the new nullable threadId field.
The PR #26639 operator-impact post is live on @decodexspace.

decision.reason: The PR combines a concrete app-server protocol change with a visible multi-agent MCP diagnostic fix.
